title: Anna's Lunch and Tea
text:
Anna likes soup for lunch. Today the soup is hot and it has carrots and potatoes. She eats it with a spoon.

In the evening, Anna drinks tea. She puts one spoon of honey in her tea. Her brother drinks cold milk.

questions.text: What does Anna eat for lunch?
Why does Anna put honey in her tea?
options: Because the doctor told her to

questions.text: What can you guess about Anna's lunch?
options: It is eaten late at night

vocabulary.definition: a liquid food, often hot, made from vegetables or meat
a tool with a round end, used to eat or stir food
a sweet, thick food made by bees
long orange vegetables that grow under the ground

paragraph_translations: Anna öğle yemeğinde çorba sever. Bugün çorba sıcak ve içinde havuç ile patates var. Onu bir kaşıkla yer.
Akşam Anna çay içer. Çayına bir kaşık bal koyar. Erkek kardeşi soğuk süt içer.
